coordinate: Fixed sensor row at x 1730 of the upright 2320 by 1744 frame. Also score using a second sightline and separately registered cup graduations.
selection: The new target rows are chosen across the visible working band, with different distances and successive directions, before the first target attempt.
scoring: Score the first measured endpoint on every requested target. Record any corrective command and the final settled error. A move inside the optical deadband needs no additional command. A separate set of cup-relative targets will test the effect of correcting camera/cup registration.
target_policy: Run the destination sequence twice. Alternate fixed-camera and cup-registered control by destination index in pass one. Exchange the policies at each destination in pass two. The previous requested destination is thereby matched. Use the same frozen width records to calibrate each coordinate. Score both modes in each coordinate.
coordinate_registration: Subtract local vertical displacement of dry front cup ink. Unused lower graduations check the displacement. Selected color and luma timestamps accompany the observations.

settling_verification.purpose: Score how long the achieved target holds after the final correction. All first-shot and correction endpoints use the early settling window used in calibration; late windows are additional observations.
